VERDICT: REPAIR
Pass 1 independently reviewed candidate c0871a8c9d31ab03394bff12f9f2de00ffb09697 (HEAD matched), its complete diff against 1c6397c740d9b64fab471a40f493c6f6acd10bcc, touched files and tests: AC-4 satisfied in implementation at src/math.mjs:68-72 and test/math.test.mjs:85-91; R-1 satisfied at src/math.mjs:69-71; R-2 satisfied at src/math.mjs:72; R-3 satisfied by the complete diff preserving all existing functions at src/math.mjs:1-66 and existing tests at test/math.test.mjs:5-83 with only the permitted import change at test/math.test.mjs:3; R-4 satisfied by no dependency or generated-file changes (package.json:1-10 unchanged); R-5 satisfied by product-prefixed test names at test/math.test.mjs:85 and :88.
Finding — medium, test/math.test.mjs:85-92: both added tests exercise only valid arrays, leaving the explicit AC-4 empty-array RangeError and R-1 invalid-shape/nonfinite-element TypeErrors without regression coverage, so removal of the validation guards would leave the product suite green; smallest verification is to add product-prefixed assertions for empty input, non-array input, and invalid/nonfinite elements, run the product filter, and confirm those assertions fail when their corresponding guards are removed.
Checks actually run: node --test --test-name-pattern="^product" test/ exited 0 with "tests 2", "pass 2", "fail 0"; npm test exited 1 with "tests 17", "pass 16", "fail 1" and sole failure "clamp respects upper bound" (15 !== 10), expected and unchanged; a read-only node --input-type=module -e probe exited 0 with "PASS: 19 independent assertions (empty, 5 shapes, 9 invalid-element arrays, frozen input, singleton, signed fractional, zero)" after an initial heredoc invocation was blocked before execution by sandbox temporary-file restrictions; git status --short was empty, no files were modified, and remaining work is durable validation-test coverage, with no observed product implementation defect or unavailable required check.
